CI-1.line_evidence: private _assemble_incremental_forecast_evaluation at lines 565-712 has NO execution-mode guard; require_authorized_execution_mode is called only at line 723 inside public run_incremental_forecast_evaluation (lines 715-724); static NO_REAL_EXECUTION_ATTESTATION map (line 135) is embedded at lines 684 and 750; _result_digest (line 559) binds that static map rather than row provenance; ForecastRow (line 304) has no provenance field.
CI-1.mechanism: Any caller routing arbitrary rows through the unguarded private assembly obtains a digest-bearing result attesting synthetic-only provenance regardless of actual row origin, because the attestation is a static constant baked into the payload and digest rather than derived from verified row provenance.

CI-2.line_evidence: lines 64-84 verify only the execution-mode string, never row provenance.
CI-2.mechanism: The synthetic wrapper authenticates a mode string, not the inputs; any row content is accepted as long as the caller declares SYNTHETIC_VALIDATION, so provenance is caller-asserted rather than structurally established.

CI-7.line_evidence: _record_exactly_one_result (lines 208-217) computes a claim digest and then discards it, recording nothing; the module attests SCIENTIFIC_RESULT_RECORDED=False at line 87.

successor_contract_requirements.PROVENANCE_IS_STRUCTURAL: Synthetic/real/evidence classification is established ONLY by verified/provenanced row types produced by authenticated factories backed by canonical receipts or Git-authenticated authorization (CI-4 digest-reconciliation pattern, CI-3 authentication pattern). A consumer must be able to independently validate why rows have the declared provenance. A constructor name, boolean, enum, string, mode value, or caller statement alone can never establish provenance.
successor_contract_requirements.NO_PRIVATE_EXECUTION_BYPASS: The hardened boundary MUST NOT import _assemble_incremental_forecast_evaluation. It reuses V0's pure scientific semantics ONLY through V0's guarded public entrypoint run_incremental_forecast_evaluation, called only after the boundary's own authority verification and structural-provenance verification succeed. The invariant scan enforces the private-import policy of frozen_v0_policy.
successor_contract_requirements.AUTHORITY_VS_PROVENANCE_VS_MODE_SEPARATI: Three independent axes: (1) execution authority - require_authorized_execution_mode plus CI-3 authenticated canonical authorization; canonical_authorization_exists() is False today, so the path fails closed; (2) input provenance - verified row types from authenticated factories; (3) semantic evaluation mode - the mode string selects evaluation semantics only. execution_mode = SYNTHETIC_VALIDATION never proves input provenance. Result classification is derived from verified input provenance, never from the static NO_REAL_EXECUTION_ATTESTATION map; that map is a frozen-V0 historical attestation, never a live classification proof.
successor_contract_requirements.EXACTLY_ONCE_DURABILITY: If the successor claims exactly-once, the identity/record mechanism must survive restart, a new process, and an independent second worker (durable store per the CI-6 pattern: remote git-ref claim or durable local append-only claim store). Process-local memory must NEVER be described as exactly-once; an honest weaker term is required (e.g. PROCESS_LOCAL_AT_MOST_ONCE). P0 may implement and test durable semantics with local durable stores and subprocesses only.
successor_contract_requirements.RESULT_RECORDING_MUST_RECORD: Any function named or documented as recording a result must perform a durable observable write/claim. A durable record is an append-only record containing at minimum {claim_identity, claim_digest, result_digest, authorization_binding (canonical git identity), recorded_at_utc, outcome_state}, independently readable after the producing process exits. If durable recording is not implemented, the recording claim must be renamed or removed and no irreversible claim consumption may be exposed.
successor_contract_requirements.CLAIM_BEFORE_OUTCOME: The sequence AUTHORIZATION VERIFIED -> IRREVERSIBLE CLAIM -> EVIDENCE AUTHENTICATED -> ROWS CONSTRUCTED -> SCIENTIFIC CORE -> RESULT RECORDED is preserved; no outcomes and no real rows may occur before a successful claim.
successor_contract_requirements.NO_REAL_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY: Hardening is offline and non-scientific: synthetic fixtures and mocks only; real outcomes and the real-capable path stay deactivated.

BEFORE_CLAIM.behavior: No side effects; rerun is allowed; 0 rows constructed and 0 scientific core invocations.

AFTER_CLAIM_BEFORE_EVALUATION.behavior: Claim is durable; a rerun with the same identity fails closed (ALREADY_CLAIMED, no outcome produced); state is observable as CLAIMED_WITHOUT_OUTCOME; resumption requires explicit governance/operational reconciliation; NO automatic retry authority is ever invented.
AFTER_CLAIM_BEFORE_EVALUATION.observable: claim store shows CLAIMED_WITHOUT_OUTCOME; no outcome record exists.

AFTER_EVALUATION_BEFORE_RECORD.behavior: A rerun fails closed on the duplicate claim (no silent re-execution); recovery is manual reconciliation appending outcome evidence under the same identity together with a reconciliation record.
AFTER_EVALUATION_BEFORE_RECORD.observable: duplicate-identity rerun returns ALREADY_CLAIMED fail-closed; recovery path is explicit and auditable, never automatic.

AFTER_RECORD_BEFORE_RETURN.behavior: The record is durable and independently observable; return-path failure is safe; duplicate identity observation is deterministic (RECORDED).
AFTER_RECORD_BEFORE_RETURN.observable: independent reader observes RECORDED with the original record fields.

replay_rules.same_identity_different_content: deterministic CONFLICT, fail-closed; no record and no outcome.
replay_rules.same_identity_identical_content: idempotent RECORDED; the original record identity is returned without a second record.

PROVENANCE_CONSTRUCTOR_HONESTY.construction_rule: Row provenance is established only by verified/provenanced row types from authenticated factories (CI-4 digest reconciliation, CI-3 authentication); constructors, names, booleans, enums, strings, modes, and caller statements cannot elevate unverified rows; adversarial tests feed arbitrary/unverified rows and prove refusal or non-elevation.

EXECUTION_MODE_IS_NOT_PROVENANCE.construction_rule: execution_mode selects evaluation semantics only; mode strings, including SYNTHETIC_VALIDATION, never prove input provenance; result classification derives from verified input provenance, never from the static NO_REAL_EXECUTION_ATTESTATION map (frozen-V0 historical attestation only).

PRIVATE_EXECUTION_SEAM_FORBIDDEN.construction_rule: The hardened boundary must not import _assemble_incremental_forecast_evaluation; reuse of V0 semantics goes only through the guarded public entrypoint run_incremental_forecast_evaluation; the invariant scan enforces frozen_v0_policy.private_import_policy with tests/ and docs/forensics/ exempt.

AUTHORITY_FAILURE_PRECEDES_ROWS.construction_rule: Execution authority is verified (require_authorized_execution_mode plus CI-3 authenticated canonical authorization; canonical_authorization_exists() False today means fail closed) before any row is constructed or any core computation runs; failed/missing authorization yields zero observable science.

EXACTLY_ONCE_PROCESS_BOUNDARY.construction_rule: If exactly-once is claimed, the claim mechanism must survive restart and a new process, proven with real subprocess restart tests against a durable store (CI-6 pattern); process-local memory may only be described with an honest weaker term such as PROCESS_LOCAL_AT_MOST_ONCE.

EXACTLY_ONCE_SECOND_WORKER.construction_rule: An independent second worker (real multiprocessing) observing the same claim identity must fail closed rather than double-record, proven against a durable store (CI-6 pattern).

CONFLICTING_REPLAY_FAILS_CLOSED.construction_rule: Same claim identity with different content yields deterministic CONFLICT and no record; same identity with identical content is idempotent RECORDED; no ambiguous partial states.

RESULT_RECORD_IS_DURABLE.construction_rule: Result recording performs a durable observable append-only write with at minimum {claim_identity, claim_digest, result_digest, authorization_binding, recorded_at_utc, outcome_state}, independently readable after the producing process exits; otherwise the recording claim is renamed/removed and no irreversible claim consumption is exposed (CI-7 lesson).

FROZEN_V0_BYTES_UNCHANGED.construction_rule: sha256(qntylab/jigsaw_funding_pressure_incremental_forecast_value_executor_v0.py) == 1ffcfeb959cfc547fcda96384c1c8f58b3f5cbc174c5d535324480ede312e8c6 and sha256(qntylab/jigsaw_funding_pressure_incremental_forecast_value_real_capable_wrapper_v1.py) == b0d30af9f6def297c23981c554d6c2224ff1736a491db009a9d8ce7fcc9a9b2e are asserted in the invariant suite.

NO_PROCESS_LOCAL_PERSISTENCE_STATE.construction_rule: No module-global dict/lock may back claimed-durable persistence (CI-10 lesson); any persistence described as durable must live in a durable store that survives process boundaries.

RESULT_RECORDING_PROSE_MATCHES_BEHAVIOR.construction_rule: Docstrings and step claims must match implemented behavior: a function claiming to record must record durably, and one that does not must not claim to (CI-7 lesson: _record_exactly_one_result computed a digest and discarded it).

AUTHORITY_FAILURE_ZERO_OBSERVABLE_SCIENC.construction_rule: Failed or missing authorization yields REAL_ROWS_CONSTRUCTED=0 and SCIENTIFIC_CORE_INVOCATIONS=0; authority-failure tests must count rows constructed and core invocations, not merely assert an exception type (HAPPY_PATH_ONLY_TEST_SMELL guard).
